text:
Asha: Quick design Q — putting a Figma link here for the compact Rollouts inspector: noticed two accessibility/UX issues when the timeline is compressed (canary view, 3 rows): ghost hover states linger after mouseout, and tooltip/order gets jumbled when scrubbing quickly. figma.com/...

Liam: Saw this in the preview — the ghost state is basically a leftover background highlight that doesn't clear. Also observed SR reads 'selected' then 'button' twice when you keyboard focus. @accessibility-bot can you run the quick check?

accessibility-bot: Automated a11y check: duplicate announcements detected. Cause: we mutate both role+label and aria-pressed on each preview step; screen reader emits role then pressed change. Suggest consolidating announcements to a single announcer container and set aria-atomic where needed.

Priya: Agree. I think we programmatically toggle aria-pressed during scrubbing which is unnecessary. For tooltips: rapid scrubbing queues tooltip show/hide and they can appear out of order. Proposal: debounce tooltip show (150ms) and cancel queued shows on next scrub tick.

Devon: UX nit: when rollout is paused we dim preview chips, but the ghost hover state looks identical to disabled. Users are confused whether preview is interactive. Suggest visible dotted outline + small "preview" microcopy on hover to make intent clear.

Asha: Good catch. For keyboard scrubbing the SR noise is the bigger blocker. Priya, can you try: single announcer div with role="status" + aria-live="polite" + aria-atomic="true"; stop toggling aria-pressed on hover preview. For tooltips, debounce 150ms and flush previous timers on new events.

Liam: 150ms sounds reasonable. Also for SR announce text, use full context: e.g. "Canary preview — v2.3.1 — 10% traffic" instead of just version. That reduces ambiguity when arrowing quickly.

Priya: Quick CSS suggestion for visual affordance: `.chip--preview { outline: 2px dashed var(--accent); opacity: 0.96; }` I'll include that in the PR. For SR I'll implement a single announcer and ensure we only update innerText (not multiple attributes) to avoid duplicate events.

Devon: Copy tweak: on hover show "Canary preview" instead of "preview" so mobile/SR users get context. For the timeline scrub tooltip, add the percent and truncated changelog summary in the announcer.

Asha: :thumbsup: Priya, can you mock the CSS + aria changes and attach VoiceOver screenshots to the PR? I'll add this to the design QA checklist and mark as high priority for the next patch release.

Priya: Will do. I'll push a draft PR today and link test plan: https://docs.internal/redwood/rollout-inspector-a11y-testplan

accessibility-bot: Reminder queued: please run axe-e2e + VoiceOver and TalkBack runs in CI for the PR, include accessibility snapshots.

Liam: After PR lands let's do a 15-min quick verification with frontend (Q) and platform ops to confirm canary snapshot timings and no regression to autosnapshot flow.

Asha: Thanks all — leaving notes in Figma and the QA checklist. We'll handle copy + microcopy in a follow-up if needed.
